clues.it: Nino era nella 7ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Olga.
clues.en: Nino was in the 7th column, in the 1st row and north of Olga.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 2ª riga, accanto a un baule da viaggio e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd row, beside a steamer trunk and west of Anna.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una poltrona di velluto e a ovest di Tea, ma non era accanto a una palma in vaso.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a velvet armchair and west of Tea, but was not beside a potted palm.

clues.it: Tea era nella 4ª riga e a nord di Ugo.
clues.en: Tea was in the 4th row and north of Ugo.

clues.it: Ugo era l'unica persona su dei bicchieri rotti e a ovest di Paolo.
clues.en: Ugo was the only person on broken glasses and west of Paolo.

clues.it: Olga era nella 6ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Olga was in the 6th column, in the 6th row and in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 7ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 7th row and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Irene era nella 12ª colonna e nella 8ª riga, ma non era accanto a dei bicchieri rotti.
clues.en: Irene was in the 12th column and in the 8th row, but was not beside broken glasses.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a un pianoforte a coda e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a grand piano and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Carla era a nord di Anna.
Anna era nella 12ª riga, accanto a un tappeto persiano e nella Suite Reale.
clues.en: Anna was in the 12th row, beside a persian carpet and in the Royal Suite.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 9th column.

steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 1st column: ruling it out leaves Ugo a single square: row 5th, column 2nd.

steps.en: Tea can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 3rd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 10ª colonna.

steps.en: The general clue “4 people in the Restaurant” cannot add up without Carla: they must be at row 11th, column 10th.

steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Winter Garden” cannot add up without Tea: they must be at row 4th, column 11th.
